annotations.title: Fetch fresh numbers from a data source

description: Fetches one connected data source now instead of waiting for its next scheduled poll: `cloudflare` (polls hourly), `bing` and `google` (daily), or `analytics` (Google Analytics, daily). Use it when the owner asks about numbers that look stale, then read them with the matching read tool. ⚠️ It uses the owner’s API limits, so it is limited to 4 a source per hour for each connection, and a burst is refused rather than queued. ⛔ It does not run a Google index sweep and cannot connect a source. A source that is not connected is refused.
name: agentimus-refresh-data

lastPollAt.description: Unix time of the last successful fetch.

refreshed.description: FALSE when nothing new was fetched, usually because another refresh was running.

title: Fetch fresh numbers from a data source
